Understand the content contract before integrating

The metadata explorer exposes the entities and endpoints that make up the Content Management domain. It helps consumers build clients against the supported public model instead of inferring relationships from database tables or implementation classes.

Use it to discover page, culture, component, layout, resource and template capabilities and to verify the shape of the API available to an application.
